turns.text: I got an email earlier about some library books that are due in the middle of the month. Could you lay out how to handle them, as far as what options there are for renewing or returning them?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text:
Good, I found two emails from Glenmont Library. Here's the situation and your options.

---

**What's on your ticket:** Three items, all due **Monday, 15 February**.

**Membership note:** Your library membership expires **28 February** — renewal must be done in person at the desk with proof of your current address.

---

**Option 1 — Return by the due date (15 Feb)**

Drop the three items off at the library before closing on the 15th. Simplest route, no fees, no membership complication. If you'll be at the branch that day, the library is on Corvid Ave — same street as the club, so could stop by on the way.

**Option 2 — Renew online (one renewal, +3 weeks)**

Each item can be renewed once, online or at the desk. That pushes the due date to roughly **8 March**. Worth checking whether any of the three has a hold from another reader — if so, that item can't be renewed and has to come back on the 15th regardless. The renewal itself is straightforward, but there's a catch: if you renew past 28 Feb and your membership lapses, you won't be able to renew again after that point. So a single renewal is fine, but it'd mean returning them in early March with a lapsed membership (still allowed — items already out stay on the ticket).

**Option 3 — Renew in person + renew membership at the same time**

If you renew the membership first (in person, proof of address), then you could renew the books at the desk too — one trip covers both. The library is open weekday hours; you could swing by before or after work.

---

**What I'd need from you to narrow it down:**

1. Do you know what the three items are? (The email didn't list titles.)
2. Do you have a sense whether you want to keep them longer or send them back?
3. Is your current address on your driving licence the same as Marden Court? That'd serve as proof for the membership renewal if you wanted to go that route.

One topic, happy to walk through whichever path you're leaning toward.
